Types

MainLoopMode = enum
  RepaintOnEvent, ## Repaints every frame (60hz or more based on display)
                   ## Updates are done every matching frame time.
                   ## Used for simple multimedia apps and games.
  RepaintOnFrame, ## Repaints every frame (60hz or more based on display)
                   ## But calls the tick function for keyboard and mouse updates at 240hz
                   ## Used for low latency games.
  RepaintSplitUpdate
Only repaints on event Used for normal for desktop UI apps. Source   Edit
